title: Tech Note: Working With Audio Files in 4D
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: WAV and MP3/ID3 are stable, well-documented legacy formats that have not meaningfully changed since this note was written, so the format knowledge and byte-level BLOB manipulation techniques described remain directly applicable in current 4D versions. Some of the custom conversion utility methods might be replaceable by newer built-in 4D commands added since 2016, but nothing here has been deprecated or broken by the classic Design Mode-to-Project Mode transition.
related_updates: Any newer native 4D BLOB/byte-conversion commands added since v15/v16 that could simplify some utility methods shown
